# String Tuner: Violin & Cello

> A free offline Android tuner for 60 instruments, with drone, metronome and intonation training. Microphone audio is analysed live and never recorded.

- [Documentation](docs/en/index.md): verified overview
- [Facts](docs/en/facts.md): store identity and dates
- [Features](docs/en/features.md): supported capabilities
- [Privacy](docs/en/privacy.md): data-safety claims
- [Limitations](docs/en/limitations.md): explicit boundaries
